text_blocks.snippet: The Pag-IBIG Multi-Purpose Loan (MPL) application form, also known as MPLAF (HQP-SLF-001), is used by Pag-IBIG Fund members to apply for a loan to address various financial needs. The form requires personal information, loan details, and authorization for salary deductions. Members can download the form online or obtain it from Pag-IBIG offices.
Key aspects of the Pag-IBIG MPL application form:

list.title: Purpose:
list.snippet: The MPL can be used for a variety of purposes, including home improvement, livelihood, tuition, health expenses, and more, according to the Pag-IBIG website.

list.title: Eligibility:
list.snippet: Members must meet certain eligibility criteria, including having made a minimum number of monthly contributions and having no outstanding short-term loans.
